instruction: Power on host and confirm the card enumerates with xbutil examine.
Program the xclbin and run the host loopback smoke test.
Run the full regression against the CPU golden and archive the log.
Measure board power at the target clock with the inline meter.
Flash the boot image and bring up PetaLinux over the serial console.
Load the bitstream through fpgautil and verify the AXI-Lite ID register.
